names.note: Name page 11906 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Николай (Шумков), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line giving only the genitive «Николая». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE, and a Cyrillic grep for «Шумков» over every `saint.json` returned nothing.

death.note: The line closes «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere, and no life page behind his name.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 августа ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая пресвитера (1937).»

attestations.note: The day's ninth entry, his own, and a separate one from the pair of 1930 standing just before it: the day prints TWO Nicholases of two different years, and this is the second. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line says «пресвитера» and name page 11906 «иерей», priest, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*shumkov*` was empty. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
